spec.name: menu-woodland-battle-hymn
spec.prompt: An organic, primal battle hymn of a forest-dwelling insect folk: earthy and warlike yet magical. Deep log drums and hand drums in a rolling war rhythm, a marimba and plucked-string ostinato, bowed double basses, a bold wooden flute and low horn melody, a chanting wordless choir, shimmering harp at the peak. Moderate driving tempo, E minor, fantasy orchestra with folk colour. A 30-second instrumental piece for a fantasy real-time strategy game's main menu, made to loop: its last bars lead back into its opening so the restart is seamless. Live orchestral and acoustic instruments only: no drum kit, no synth leads, no electronic or modern pop sound, no sung words.
